title: TrustLens
oneLiner: A browser extension that flags questionable content while you read.
shortSummary: A partially implemented Chrome extension analysing page content in real time to surface likely misinformation.
responsibilities: Built the content-analysis pass against the Chrome extension APIs.
constraints: Judging credibility automatically is a hard problem, and the accuracy needed to be useful was beyond what the approach could reach.
outcomes: Partially implemented and stopped — the classification quality was not good enough to be trustworthy, which is the one thing this kind of tool cannot get wrong.
